title: Noise restrictions at night
question: What are the quiet hours in Poland and what noise is allowed at night?
short_answer: Quiet hours are typically 22:00–6:00. Loud noise during this time is prohibited.
conditions: Standard quiet hours: 22:00 to 6:00 (local municipalities may set different times)
During quiet hours, noise must not disturb neighbours
This applies to music, parties, renovation work, and loud conversations
Renovation works are typically allowed only 8:00–20:00 on weekdays
exceptions: Public events with permits may exceed noise limits
Emergency work (water pipe breaks, etc.) is permitted at any time
New Year's Eve — local municipalities often extend noise permissions
penalties: Fine: 20–5000 PLN for disturbing the peace
Police may be called by neighbours
Repeated violations can lead to eviction proceedings
